settings.question: What is your shipping policy?
settings.answer: We ship across Egypt. Delivery times vary by city; you'll see estimates at checkout.

settings.question: How do returns work?
settings.answer: Unused items in original packaging may be returned within 14 days. Contact us to start a return.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: You'll receive tracking by email once your order ships. You can also view orders in your account.
